name: Heroku
description: Heroku is a cloud application platform for deploying, running, and operating applications. Teams use Apps, Releases, and Dynos to understand deployed application state and runtime lifecycle.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Heroku Team and selected App through Relay's confidential OAuth client with only the read scope, then let agents list a bounded first range of Team Apps and inspect redacted Release and Dyno lifecycle summaries for the selected App. Relay V1 excludes config vars, credential-bearing metadata, log drains and sessions, commands, attach and output streams, add-ons, source, writes, administration, arbitrary REST, and pagination.

credentialRequirements.name: HEROKU_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Heroku OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay-owned confidential OAuth client ID configured only on Railway.

credentialRequirements.name: HEROKU_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Heroku OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay-owned confidential OAuth client secret configured only on Railway.

credentialRequirements.name: HEROKU_TEAM_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Heroku Team UUID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind the connection to one exact Heroku Team UUID before authorization.

credentialRequirements.name: HEROKU_APP_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Heroku App UUID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind the connection to one exact selected Heroku App UUID before authorization.

capabilities.label: Read Apps
capabilities.description: List bounded Apps in one exact Team.

capabilities.label: Read Releases
capabilities.description: List bounded redacted Release lifecycle summaries for one selected App.

capabilities.label: Read Dynos
capabilities.description: List bounded redacted Dyno lifecycle summaries for one selected App.

approvalRequired.label: List Team Apps
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five Apps from the first bounded range of one exact Team.

approvalRequired.label: List App Releases
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five redacted Release lifecycle summaries for one selected App.

approvalRequired.label: List App Dynos
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five redacted Dyno lifecycle summaries for one selected App.

blocked.label: Change Apps
blocked.description: App creation, configuration, maintenance, transfer, archive, rename, and deletion are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Releases or Dynos
blocked.description: Deploy, release, rollback, scale, restart, stop, run, attach, and command execution are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read sensitive platform data
blocked.description: Config vars, log drains and sessions, commands, attach/output URLs, add-on credentials, source, slugs, files, builds, and pipelines are outside V1.

blocked.label: Administer Heroku
blocked.description: Members, collaborators, permissions, billing, invoices, OAuth clients and authorizations, webhooks, domains, certificates, tokens, and account administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use raw Heroku API
blocked.description: Arbitrary REST, hosts, paths, headers, ranges, cursors, pagination, and raw responses are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three bounded Heroku reads require matching approval because the provider read scope covers more resources than Relay mounts.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact Team/App binding, fixed requests, limits, redaction, audit, token refresh, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three fixed Heroku read wrappers and attaches refreshed OAuth access tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's confidential Heroku OAuth client, exact Railway callback, read scope, and staging client credentials require provider-console completion and authorized staging acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register the confidential Heroku OAuth client with Relay's exact Railway callback, configure staging credentials, and validate exact-scope consent, Team/App binding, refresh, revoke, denial, and the three bounded reads.

evidence.supports: Heroku documents confidential authorization-code OAuth, CSRF state, exact read scope, eight-hour access tokens, non-expiring refresh tokens, refresh exchange, and the warning that some broad read resources can expose credentials.

Heroku's current Platform API reference documents the fixed API origin and media type, bounded Range semantics, rate limits, Team App list, Release list, Dyno list, response schemas, and the sensitive fields Relay excludes.
